title: Single-cell transcriptomics identifies PRDX1 and GPX4 as potential ferroptosis regulators and tumor microenvironment--related molecules in hepatocellular carcinoma.
snippet: The present study aimed to investigate the expression and roles of peroxiredoxin 1 (PRDX1) and glutathione (GSH) peroxidase 4 (GPX4) in ferroptosis regulation and the tumor microenvironment in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). The expression levels of PRDX1 and GPX4 were assessed in HCC through analysis of datasets from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), GSE1452...
